---
title: "REDCap Apache & PHP Log Forensic Report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    number_sections: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ------------------------------
# Load packages 
# ------------------------------
packages <- c("data.table", "tidyverse", "lubridate", "stringr", "DT")
missing <- packages[!sapply(packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Please install required packages before knitting: ",
       paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}
lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)

# ------------------------------
# Paths
# ------------------------------
apache_log_file <- "C:/wamp64/logs/access.log"
php_log_file    <- "C:/wamp64/logs/php_error.log"

# ------------------------------
# Parse Apache log
# ------------------------------
logs <- readLines(apache_log_file, warn = FALSE)
log <- data.table(raw = logs)
log[, raw := str_replace_all(raw, '^"|"$', '')]
log[, raw := str_trim(raw)]
log <- log[str_detect(raw, "^::1|^\\d{1,3}(\\.\\d{1,3}){3}")]

split_cols <- tstrsplit(log$raw, " ", fixed = TRUE)
log[, ip := split_cols[[1]]]
log[, dash1 := split_cols[[2]]]
log[, dash2 := split_cols[[3]]]
log[, time_part := split_cols[[4]]]
log[, request_status := paste(split_cols[5:length(split_cols)], collapse = " ")]

log[, time := str_extract(raw, "\\d{2}/[A-Za-z]{3}/\\d{4}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2} [-+]\\d{4}")]
log[, time := as.POSIXct(time, format="%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z", tz="UTC")]

log[, request := str_extract(raw, '"(.*?)"')]
log[, request := str_replace_all(request, '"', '')]
log[, status := as.integer(str_extract(raw, '\\s(\\d{3})\\s'))]

log[, c("method","uri","protocol") := {
  tmp <- tstrsplit(request, " ", fixed = TRUE)
  list(
    if(length(tmp) >= 1) tmp[[1]] else NA_character_,
    if(length(tmp) >= 2) tmp[[2]] else NA_character_,
    if(length(tmp) >= 3) tmp[[3]] else NA_character_
  )
}]
log[, bytes := NA_integer_]
log <- log[, .(ip, time, method, uri, protocol, status, bytes, raw)]

# ------------------------------
# Forensic Queries
# ------------------------------
install_hits <- log[uri %like% "install\\.php",
                    .(count=.N, first=min(time), last=max(time)),
                    by=.(ip, uri)][order(-count)]

client_errors <- log[status >= 400 & status < 500, .N, by=ip][order(-N)]
server_errors <- log[status >= 500, .N, by=ip][order(-N)]
unusual_methods <- log[!method %in% c("GET","POST"), .N, by=.(ip, method)][order(-N)]

suspicious_patterns <- "(?i)union|select|sleep\\(|benchmark\\(|\\.\\./|cmd=|exec="
suspicious_uris <- log[str_detect(uri, suspicious_patterns), .N, by=.(ip, uri)][order(-N)]

log[, minute := lubridate::floor_date(time, unit = "minute")]
high_request_rate <- log[, .N, by=.(ip, minute)][N > 50][order(-N)]


# ------------------------------
# Parse PHP log (defensive)
# ------------------------------
if (!file.exists(php_log_file)) {
  warning("PHP log file not found: ", php_log_file)
  php_error_counts <- data.table()
  php_top_messages <- data.table()
} else {
  php_logs <- readLines(php_log_file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")

  # Pattern: [datetime] PHP <Type>: <Message>
  # Examples matched:
  # [28-Feb-2026 14:12:03 UTC] PHP Warning: Something...
  # [28-Feb-2026 14:12:03] PHP Fatal error: Something...
  php_pattern <- '^\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\\s+PHP\\s+([^:]+):\\s+(.*)$'

  m <- stringr::str_match(php_logs, php_pattern)  # matrix
  # m[,1] = full match, m[,2] = datetime, m[,3] = type, m[,4] = message

  if (is.null(m) || ncol(m) < 4) {
    # No usable matches; create empty outputs and warn
    warning(
      "PHP log pattern did not match any lines. ",
      "First few lines:\n",
      paste(utils::head(php_logs, 5), collapse = "\n")
    )
    php_error_counts <- data.table()
    php_top_messages <- data.table()
  } else {
    php_df <- as.data.frame(m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(php_df) <- c("full", "datetime", "type", "message")
    php_df <- php_df[, c("datetime", "type", "message")]

    # Parse datetime with or without timezone token
    php_df$datetime <- lubridate::parse_date_time(
      php_df$datetime,
      orders = c("d-b-Y H:M:S", "d-b-Y H:M:S z"),
      tz = "UTC"
    )

    # Keep rows with non-missing structure
    php_df <- php_df[!is.na(php_df$type) & !is.na(php_df$message), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(php_df)) {
      php_error_counts <- dplyr::count(php_df, type, sort = TRUE)
      php_top_messages <- dplyr::count(php_df, message, sort = TRUE) %>% head(5)
    } else {
      php_error_counts <- data.table()
      php_top_messages <- data.table()
    }
  }
}
```

## Apache Log (Latest 20 Entries)
```{r}
datatable(log[order(-time)][1:20])
```

```{r}
datatable(install_hits)
```
